about.title: A bit about me
about.description: I care about doing my work well, the people I do it with, and building things with real impact.

who.title: Who I am
who.body: I'm Florencia, a Junior Full Stack Developer based in Madrid. I made the leap into tech after discovering how much I love turning ideas into things people can actually use.

passion.title: My passion for tech
passion.body: I enjoy every part of the process: clean code, thoughtful UX, and the small details that make a product feel right.

learning.title: Currently learning
learning.body: Diving deeper into system design, testing, and how to build powerful apps in the AI era. Always stepping out of my comfort zone.

goals.title: Professional goals
goals.body: To join a team where I can grow as a professional and build products that matter.

philosophy.title: Work philosophy
philosophy.body: Communicate early, write code others can read, and treat feedback as a gift. Consistency beats intensity.

fun.title: Off the keyboard
fun.body: Bouldering, specialty argentinian mate, and far too many half-finished side projects.
